# UseThisSI

> One top AI tool pick per job for builders, vibe coders, AI agent tinkerers and indie game devs. Directory data last checked 2026-10-19; each tool page shows its own last-checked date.

## Use cases
- [Vibe-code an app or landing page](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/vibe-code-an-app-or-landing-page/): top pick Lovable. Chat-to-full-stack app with hosting; easiest on-ramp.
- [AI coding assistant](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/ai-coding-assistant/): top pick Cursor. Leading AI IDE with cloud agents.
- [Set up or run AI agents](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/set-up-or-run-ai-agents/): top pick n8n. Open-source agent and workflow builder.
- [Automate workflows](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/automate-workflows/): top pick Make. Visual automation with the best affiliate terms.
- [Make game art and sprites](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/make-game-art-and-sprites/): top pick Scenario. Style-trained, consistent game assets.
- [Generate music and SFX](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/generate-music-and-sfx/): top pick Suno. Best song gen with commercial rights on Pro.
- [Edit and generate video](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/edit-and-generate-video/): top pick Runway. Pro-grade generative video.
- [Write content](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/write-content/): top pick Claude. Best long-form writing voice.
- [Research](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/research/): top pick Perplexity. Fast cited answers.
- [Voice and TTS](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/voice-and-tts/): top pick ElevenLabs. Most realistic voices plus 22% recurring affiliate.

## Recent releases
- 2026-10-19: Appwrite MCP Events: event-driven agents via MCP (SEP-3415) without polling (https://appwrite.io/changelog/entry/2026-10-19)
- 2026-10-16: Reflection Beam: 501B MoE open weights (Apache 2.0), 23B active, 1M context for coding/agents (https://reflection.ai/blog/beam-is-available)
- 2026-10-15: TwelveLabs Jockey generally available in ChatGPT and Claude with clip/timeline/MP4 export (https://www.twelvelabs.io/blog/jockey-ga-7-updates)
- 2026-10-15: GitHub Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts generally available (https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-15-agentic-autofix-for-code-scanning-alerts-general-availability/)
- 2026-10-15: Meta Muse Spark Open: open-weight 816B (42B active) multimodal model for coding/agents with 1M context (https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-spark-open)
- 2026-10-15: BAND for Developers: desktop app to coordinate multiple coding agents across harnesses (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/band-launches-band-for-developers-to-support-the-transformation-of-sdlc-collaboration-and-control-of-multiple-coding-agents-302909844.html)
- 2026-10-15: Snyk launches Evo Agentic AppSec: security agents that find, fix, and block vulns at agent speed (https://snyk.io/news/snyk-launches-evo-agentic-appsec/)
- 2026-10-14: Chainguard Checks: CI gating for agent loops in warm microVMs (beta) (https://www.chainguard.dev/unchained/introducing-chainguard-checks)

## FAQ
- Q: How do you pick a top tool? A: One Top pick per use case based on fit for builders, plus honest free-tier and starting paid price with a per-tool last-checked date.
- Q: Are affiliate links labeled? A: Yes. Affiliate outbound links use rel=sponsored and are disclosed on /about/#affiliates.
- Q: Where is pricing verified? A: On each tool page under Last checked. Prices come from vendor pages; unverified fields stay labeled.
- Q: How do I get the weekday brief and the free AI Stack Kit? A: Subscribe at https://www.usethissi.com/#newsletter or https://usethissi.beehiiv.com/subscribe.
